payload.release_notes:
- Verify signed updates and valid hardware-bound licenses using trusted server time; Windows clock drift no longer creates a redundant application lockout.
- Network and System update checks use bounded pinned raw/API fallback and actionable connection/TLS/signature errors.
- System shows real downloaded MB, total and speed, supports cancellation and Retry, and starts the verified installer silently.
- Recoverable System startup verification failures remain visible with safe retry; invalid, expired and revoked licenses stay refused.
- Network keeps resume metadata in its private profile and hides reserved internal sidecars while preserving genuine user JSON and unfinished transfers.
- Production downloads use readable flat filenames; existing artwork and edits are preserved, and only exact empty legacy internal folders are cleaned.
- Existing shared Add/Delete/Restore, file color marks, generated Nest output completion, automatic System pairing, single-instance startup, installer password and signed payload protection are retained.
